---
title: "logistic_regression_hd"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
load("heart_disease_split.RData")

head(hd_training)
head(hd_testing)
```



```{r}
# Fit logistic regression model
log_model <- glm(
  target ~ .,
  data = hd_training,
  family = binomial
)

# View model summary
summary(log_model)

```

```{r}
# Predict probabilities
test_prob <- predict(
  log_model,
  newdata = hd_testing,
  type = "response"
)

head(test_prob)

```

```{r}
# Class label conversion
test_pred <- ifelse(test_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)

# Convert to factor for caret
test_pred <- factor(test_pred, levels = c(0,1))
hd_testing$target <- factor(hd_testing$target, levels = c(0,1))

```

```{r}
confusionMatrix(test_pred, hd_testing$target)

```

```{r}
plot_data <- hd_testing
plot_data$pred_prob <- test_prob

#Graph of probability -v- outcome
boxplot(
  pred_prob ~ target,
  data = plot_data,
  col = c("lightgray", "lightblue"),
  names = c("No Heart Disease", "Heart Disease"),
  ylab = "Predicted Probability",
  main = "Predicted Probabilities by True Outcome"
)

```
